text:
This is the CBC filming crew
CBC people
How many? 3 guys probably between 25 - 35 years old
What gear did they have?  They had a full size 16mm movie camera
was there a reporter as well as a camera man? Yes a new reporter
Did they say where they were from in Canada? I think maybe Toronto or Montreal. Just a guess.
Where were you when they filmed? On The Mountain (Nui Ba Den), we are at the very point of the top. 50 to 100 yards down the north side. That trail goes around to the east side around and there's a big temple they built there, it's all new stuff but not all the way to the top, where I was.

I took the photo. The other 4 are Cambodians coming back from patrol.

rough timeframe: I think it would be Nov or Dec of 1964 (best guess)
